## Why

Describe the concrete problem or research question.

## Change

Explain the resulting behavior and any compatibility changes.

## Validation

Give the exact command, environment and result. For empirical claims, link raw evidence
and state the dataset, seed, hardware and baseline. Distinguish layer/kernel timing from
whole-model timing, and persistent bytes from training peak.

## Limits

State remaining risks, skipped hardware checks, and any evidence this change supersedes.
